ops.title: v0.22: delete the cross-era gate, the legacy account-terminal sweep, and the bbolt dependency together
ops.description:
The v0.21 migration carries three pieces of one-cycle transition machinery that
must be deleted together after the release soaks. They are correct today and
become dead weight the moment no v0.20.9 installation remains.

1. `internal/daemon/crossera.go` — the §B cross-era gate: launchd.RemoveUnmarked,
   then a blocking acquire of the legacy `socket+".lock"`, then claim.
2. `internal/daemon/crossera_terminals.go` — the legacy account-terminal sweep
   added for review finding F2 (commit f0e01bf). v0.20.9 tracked PTY children in
   `account-terminals-v1.db`; daemonkit v0.21's recovery covers only the record
   store Serve derives, so nothing read that ledger after `Manager.Recover` was
   deleted. A survivor from a crashed v0.20.9 daemon would race a rearmed
   `claude auth login` into the same CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and overwrite the user's
   credentials.
3. `go.etcd.io/bbolt` — added as a direct dependency by that fix, used by
   nothing else in the tree (`crossera_terminals.go` and its test only). The
   legacy ledger is a bbolt database; reading it requires the driver.

Note daemonkit is shedding bbolt on the same schedule for the same reason — see
daemonkit backlog 056cb1d, "v0.22: delete the bbolt legacy sweep and the bbolt
dep." cc-pool taking the dependency for one cycle mirrors that pattern rather
than diverging from it, but it means the two deletions should be checked
together.

Safety properties worth preserving in the reader's memory until then: the sweep
probes each recorded {pid, start_time} with the v0.20.9 stamp encoding and
SIGKILLs group-wide ONLY while the process still sits in its recorded dedicated
session, so a reused PID reads as settled and is never signalled. The ledger
archives only after exact settlement, and a child that cannot be proven gone
fails the boot rather than racing a new login — fail-closed, because the
alternative is credential destruction.

ops.text: internal/daemon/crossera.go and crossera_terminals.go (plus their tests) are deleted after the v0.21 soak
go.etcd.io/bbolt is removed from go.mod — it exists solely to read the v0.20.9 account-terminals-v1.db ledger
internal/pool/paths.go's AccountTerminalProcessStorePath is removed once nothing reads the legacy ledger
